title: Segmentation-guided cost optimizer and safe-apply framework for per-customer batching/caching
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a recommendation and safe-apply system that generates per-customer and per-route batching/caching configuration suggestions using segmentation heuristics, and applies them via a guarded rollout that supports dry-run, shadow-apply, canary, and automatic rollback triggers.
background: We currently have manual tuning guidance for batching and KV cache configuration. Customers and internal teams need repeatable, auditable recommendations that reduce unit cost without violating latency SLOs or correctness. Several customers in Dedicated and Private deployments have asked for automated, per-customer tuning with explicit safety controls and auditable rollbacks.
goals: Create a Horizon Recommender that produces ranked batching/caching suggestions per-route and per-customer segment
Segment customers into micro-tiers (gold/silver/bronze + specialized patterns) and expose allowlist/denylist controls for aggressive optimizations
Implement a safe-apply framework supporting dry-run, shadow-apply (metrics only), incremental canary, and automated rollback on regressions
Provide audit logs, explainability metadata for each recommendation, and a console view for reviewing and approving changes
Integrate regression detection with our QA evals and latency/cost SLOs to trigger immediate rollback when necessary
proposed_solution: Data collection: augment existing telemetry to capture per-request features used by the recommender (seq_len_dist, prompt_prefix_hash, client_tier, route, cache_hit_rate, batching_window_utilization)

Segmentation engine: implement deterministic bucketing rules with override allowlist/denylist per-customer and per-route. Buckets include: stable-high-throughput, spiky-low-latency, prefix-heavy, and long-seq workloads

Horizon Recommender: for each bucket, run an offline cost-latency sweep (simulated batching and KV-cache configs) producing candidate configs with estimated cost delta and latency risk score; surface top-3 candidates with explanation strings

Safe-apply framework: three action modes - dry-run (no state change, generates report), shadow-apply (apply config to shadow runtime metrics only), staged apply (canary percent then ramp), full apply with pin/version), each action emits audit events

Regression detection: continuous probes (synthetic and live sampled traffic) measure 95th/99th latency, token-cost, and functional correctness via eval prompt sets; define thresholds and an early-stop algorithm that triggers rollback and alerting

Console and API: expose recommendations, allowlist/denylist controls, per-segment rollout controls, and manual approve/force-rollback paths; provide links to underlying telemetry and generated PRs for auditability
acceptance_criteria: Horizon Recommender produces recommendations for at least 80% of active routes in staging and 60% in production without manual labeling
Shadow-apply mode runs for a selected customer segment and produces isolated metrics dashboards showing expected cost delta and latency impact
Staged apply canary supports 0.5%, 1%, 5%, 25% increments with automated progression or rollback based on configurable thresholds
Automatic rollback triggers when 95th or 99th latency increases beyond defined SLA delta OR when functional regression evaluation fails for more than 0.5% of probes
Audit trail (who/what/when) recorded for every recommendation and action; console displays explanation text and link to data artifacts (GDrive Confluence, GitHub PR, dashboard)
rollout_plan: Week 0-2: Instrument additional telemetry in staging and feed a historical replay pipeline for offline sweeps
Week 3-4: Deploy Horizon Recommender in read-only mode in staging, generate candidate reports for QA and PM review
Week 5: Enable shadow-apply for opt-in customers in staging and run 2 weeks of shadow observation
Week 6-7: Canary staged apply to internal test accounts (1% traffic) with full rollback automation enabled
Week 8: Start customer pilot with 3 low-risk customers (bronze/stable-throughput) and collect data for full rollout
Post-rollout: iterate on recommender heuristics and expand segmentation mapping; warmup documentation and runbook updates
safety_and_rollback: All applied changes are versioned with config pins and keep a previous-state snapshot to support instant reversion
Rollback triggers: latency SLA breach, increase in error-rate >0.2%, functional eval regression, manual cancellation from on-call
Shadow-apply never modifies live traffic; canary apply route isolation ensures only a subset of customer requests are affected
Automatic rollback is coupled with a post-mortem checklist auto-created in the incident tracker and a notification to the owning account team
We will implement a forced 'freeze' that rejects any automated apply for customers with an explicit denylist flag
metrics_and_alerts: Primary metrics: cost per 1k tokens (estimated and observed), 95th/99th latency, request error rate, cache hit ratio
Secondary metrics: batch size distribution, KV cache warmup time, tail token generation time
Alerts: immediate P1 alert when automatic rollback is triggered; daily digest for recommended changes and shadow-vs-live delta
Dashboards: per-customer segment view showing candidate ranking, forecasted monthly cost savings, and simulated latency risk
implementation_notes: Coordination: sync with infra on safe-apply API (owns canary routing) and with security on audit schema
We will add an explainability JSON blob with each recommendation: reason, confidence, simulated traces link
